projectDescription: A desktop application for managing and syncing cloud storage, built with Electron and a native GTK4/Adwaita UI.
keyFeatures: Manage multiple cloud storage remotes (Google Drive, Dropbox, Nextcloud, pCloud, Proton Drive, WebDAV) from a single interface
Sync local directories to cloud remote paths with real-time status tracking
View and resolve sync errors including file conflicts with keep-local or keep-remote options
Manage per-directory file/folder exclusion glob patterns
Native GTK4/Adwaita look-and-feel via gtk-js on Electron, with responsive sidebar + detail navigation
Frameless, transparent window with full window management (minimize, maximize, close) through custom IPC
Adaptive layout with animated Leaflet sidebar folding for narrow windows
Type-safe IPC layer between Electron main and renderer processes
publicApiSurface: IPC channel: window:set-decoration-insets (top, right, bottom, left)
Type: SyncDir { id, remoteId, localPath, remotePath, status, errors, exclusions }
Mock store action: ADD_EXCLUSION / UPDATE_EXCLUSION / REMOVE_EXCLUSION
